caseNameFull: Heiner, Former Collector of Internal Revenue v. A. W. Mellon and Same v. Jennie King Mellon
attorneys: Solicitor General Reed for petitioner. Messrs. William Wallace Booth, John G. Frazer, and Donald D. Shepard for respondents.

opinions.text:
Petition for writs of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit granted.

Reported below: 89 F. (2d) 141.

The Chief Justice and Mr. Justice Stone took no part in the consideration and decision of this application.
